patches.name: New Bark Cave + Free Shop
patches.description: A compact shop in the cave's northwest corner leaves room for future town buildings. Two clerks behind the counter offer all seven reusable HMs and free supplies: Potions, Full Restore, Revive, Full Heal, and Poké/Great/Ultra/Master Balls. Everything costs ¥0 with normal quantities and bag limits. Includes all earlier cave, starter and EXP-option features.
patches.notes: Back up your normal cartridge save before upgrading. Older cave saves in the new building footprint move safely to its front door; other positions and save layout are preserved. Field HMs still need their normal badges. Stock is unlimited; other marts keep normal prices. Saves inside this shop need v1.5+. Use CONTINUE, not a numbered state from another ROM. Complete playthrough remains unverified.

patches.name: New Bark Cave
patches.description: An empty, fully lit cave at Route 29's east end, just west of New Bark Town. One open chamber with a south exit back to the route. Reach it after choosing your first starter; no Flash, badges, or HMs needed. No wild encounters, trainers, NPCs, items, or quests yet. Includes all six-starter and EXP-option features from v1.3.
patches.notes: Empty cave test build. Back up your normal cartridge save before upgrading. Existing map IDs, progress flags, and save layout are preserved; v1.3 save/reopen tested. Saves inside the cave require v1.4 or newer: leave and save outside before reverting to an older patch. Use CONTINUE, not numbered states from another ROM. Complete playthrough remains unverified.

patches.name: All Six Starters + EXP Options
patches.description: Collect all six Kanto and Johto starters from Elm once each, with the shrinking menu from v1.2. In the game's START → OPTION menu, choose EXP GAIN from 1x to 10x with Left/Right. Default 1x; saved with normal game options. Multiplies battle EXP after trainer/traded/Lucky Egg bonuses, including EXP SHARE awards. Gameplay speed is independent.
patches.notes: Back up your normal cartridge save before upgrading from v1.1/v1.2. Existing save layout and flags are preserved; old options default to 1x. Use CONTINUE rather than a numbered state from another patch. Stat EXP and the level-100 cap are unchanged. v1.0 upgrades and complete playthrough remain unverified.

patches.name: Collect All Six Starters
patches.description: Choose your first Kanto or Johto starter as before, then return to Professor Elm for the other five. Receive each species only once; the menu shrinks after every successful gift. Elm offers another companion after his normal quest dialogue. Gifts are level 5 with a Berry, and only the first choice determines the rival's original Johto counter type.
patches.notes: Includes permanent claim tracking and migration for v1.1 cartridge saves using previously caught starter species. Back up your cartridge save before changing versions. Make room in your party for each gift. Cancel/decline and full parties preserve unclaimed gifts. Do not transfer numbered save states across versions; v1.0 upgrades and complete playthrough remain unverified.

patches.name: Kanto + Johto Six Starters
patches.description: Choose Bulbasaur, Charmander, Squirtle, Chikorita, Cyndaquil, or Totodile from a six-choice menu at any Poké Ball in Professor Elm's lab. Preview and confirm one level-5 partner holding a Berry. The rival uses the original Johto starter that counters your chosen type. Original world, story, graphics, and music remain.
patches.notes: Start a new game to choose a starter. B cancels the menu. Experimental: full playthrough and cross-version save compatibility are unverified. Keep existing saves on their original patch version.

patches.name: Johto Custom Starters + Rival
patches.description: Professor Elm offers Mareep, Houndour, or Larvitar instead of Cyndaquil, Totodile, or Chikorita. Rival battles use their corresponding evolution lines (Ampharos, Houndoom, Tyranitar), with custom move choices. The original world, story, graphics, and music remain intact.
patches.notes: Experimental. Rival dialogue and long-term save compatibility have not yet been fully verified.
